messages.subject: New paper on seizure modeling using/citing Stan
parts:
hi

We've just had a paper on patient-specific forward and inverse modeling of seizure spread in clinical epilepsy. The model inversion was done with Stan (w/ ADVI) which we cited. The paper's here

http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1053811916300891



Cheers,
Marmaduke
